title: GeSIM
tagline: AI-Driven blockchain travel eSIM: Connect globally, Pay locally
description:
GeSIM exists to break down the barriers of traditional telecom—centralized control, data surveillance, rigid borders, and outdated billing systems.

Today’s mobile connectivity is locked behind national regulations, KYC requirements, and data monopolies. Travelers, remote workers, and privacy-conscious users are forced to depend on fragmented, expensive, and intrusive telecom providers.

GeSIM flips this model.
By combining blockchain, eSIM technology, and token-gated access, we offer a borderless, privacy-first alternative. You pay only for what you use, access data anywhere in the world without paperwork, and stay pseudonymous by design.

Much like the Open Sky Treaty opened airspace for peaceful, cooperative use—GeSIM opens the telecom layer, enabling anyone to plug into global mobile data without asking for permission.

We’re building telecom as it should be:
Open. Decentralized. User-owned.
how_its_made: GeSIM combines eSIM OTA provisioning and carrier-profile orchestration with blockchain smart contracts for pay-on-usage settlement in stablecoins, DID-based on-chain identity, oracle-fed coverage/pricing data, secure key storage, real-time telemetry and policy engines, plus mobile SDKs — all layered with privacy-preserving protocols.
